description: This is an Android Java source file defining the main activity (WearableMainActivity) for a wearable speed tracker app. It manages UI components, location updates via GoogleApiClient, runtime permissions, and interactions for setting speed limits and location permissions. The activity displays current speed, updates location data to the data layer, and adjusts UI based on GPS signal and permissions.

classes.name: WearableMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the wearable speed tracker app, managing UI, location updates, permissions, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, permissions, and GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes location updates and disconnects GoogleApiClient when activity pauses.

methods.name: onSpeedLimitClick
methods.description: Starts activity to pick a new speed limit.

methods.name: onGpsPermissionClick
methods.description: Requests location permission if not granted.

methods.name: updateActivityViewsBasedOnLocationPermissions
methods.description: Adjusts UI elements based on GPS permission status and signal availability.

methods.name: updateSpeedInViews
methods.description: Updates speed display, color coding based on speed relative to limit, and blinking indicator.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Called when GoogleApiClient connects; requests location updates.

methods.name: requestLocation
methods.description: Sets up location request parameters and requests location updates.

methods.name: onLocationChanged
methods.description: Processes new GPS location, updates UI, and sends data to wearable data layer.

methods.name: addLocationEntry
methods.description: Creates and sends location data to the data layer for storage or processing.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from speed limit picker activity, updates preferences.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user response to location permission requests.

methods.name: hasGps
methods.description: Checks if device hardware supports GPS.
